log: A `joinCityRefusal` provider on Unit sends `{ reason: 'too-large', size }` for a Settlers standing in one of its player's cities that the `can-join-city/size-limit` rule refuses, and `null` otherwise, so a renderer can explain the refusal (as v474.05's `*ADDCITY` warning does) without repeating the rule (civ-clone/web-renderer#279).
The rule and the provider share `tooLargeToJoin` from canJoinCity.ts. Registered through `registerAdditionalData(game)`, imported from index.ts. Adds core-data-object as a dependency.
